title: Alexis, Unbound
author: A.C. Eberhardt and K. Twomey
description:
Welcome to the world of ALEXIS, UNBOUND - a sapphic mystery/horror interactive fiction novel inspired by Bluebeard.

At the height of the Regency period, you play as Alexis Darrow, a young Irish maid in love with Lavinia Irving, the daughter of your harsh middle class employers.

When Lavinia is chosen by the mysterious Lord and Lady Gormley to participate in a 'friendly' competition for girls of common birth to become educated in the ways of an aristocrat's wife, you vow to win her back... but at what cost?

Content warnings: horror elements, violence, mentions of sexual assault, period typical homophobia.
